**Sundhedsklynge Midt** is a healthcare cluster operating within [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] in Denmark. It serves as a local administrative and clinical subdivision monitored by the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) to evaluate and improve the treatment of patients with [[atrieflimren]].

In the 2024 national quality report on atrial fibrillation, Sundhedsklynge Midt is highlighted for its performance across multiple clinical quality indicators. Notably, it is recognized as one of the healthcare clusters that successfully met the national standard for Indicator 1, achieving a compliance rate of 91.9% for the timely initiation of anticoagulation therapy in newly diagnosed patients [^src1]. The cluster's clinical outcomes are comprehensively tracked throughout the report, with granular data provided on 1-year, 2-year, and 5-year treatment coverage [^src2], annual P-creatinine monitoring [^src4], and the incidence of severe bleeding and heart failure within one year of a new diagnosis [^src6] [^src7].

Furthermore, the cluster is featured in broader epidemiological and geographic analyses. It is included in the national mapping of the incidence of ischemic stroke (apoplexy) among atrial fibrillation patients ([[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]), where its outcomes are categorized within specific statistical intervals alongside other Danish health clusters to visualize regional variations [^src4]. By providing hierarchical data that breaks down from the national level to Region Midtjylland and finally to Sundhedsklynge Midt, the RKKP enables targeted quality improvement initiatives and local clinical benchmarking [^src5].
